name: io.github.sovroutecore/sovroute-mcp
title: SovRoute
description: Bare-metal Bitcoin Core v31.1 & EVM pre-sign security guardrails via MCP and HTTP 402.

tools.name: get_bitcoin_smart_fees
tools.description: Read-only, side-effect-free query that fetches real-time Bitcoin mainnet fee rates (sat/vB) across confirmation targets directly from bare-metal Bitcoin Core v31.1 RPC. Use this before constructing or pricing a Bitcoin transaction; use get_mempool_entropy for overall mempool congestion/vsize or get_next_block_xray to see if a specific txid fits in the next block template.

tools.name: get_mempool_entropy
tools.description: Read-only, side-effect-free query that fetches live Bitcoin mainnet mempool statistics (unconfirmed transaction count, virtual size, total fee pool) from Bitcoin Core RPC. Use this to gauge network-wide congestion before broadcasting; use get_bitcoin_smart_fees for target sat/vB fee rates or get_next_block_xray for candidate block template inclusion.

tools.name: check_rbf_fraud_shield
tools.description: Read-only, side-effect-free inspection of an unconfirmed Bitcoin transaction ID for BIP-125 Replace-By-Fee (RBF) double-spend replaceability, fee rate, and unconfirmed ancestor chains. Use this when evaluating an incoming 0-conf Bitcoin txid; use simulate_raw_transaction to validate an unsigned/signed raw tx hex before broadcast, or preflight_transaction_guard for a unified ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK verdict.

tools.name: get_next_block_xray
tools.description: Read-only, side-effect-free inspection of the live Bitcoin Core candidate block template (getblocktemplate) showing cutoff fee rates and optional txid queue rank. Use this to check whether a pending txid is likely to enter the very next block; use get_bitcoin_smart_fees for general fee estimation or check_rbf_fraud_shield for 0-conf double-spend risk.

txid.description: Optional 64-character hex Bitcoin transaction ID to inspect for inclusion rank

tools.name: simulate_raw_transaction
tools.description: Read-only, zero-broadcast Bitcoin Core v31.1 consensus and script dry-run (testmempoolaccept) that never broadcasts to the P2P network. Use this to verify a raw signed Bitcoin transaction hex before broadcasting; use check_rbf_fraud_shield to inspect an already-mempool txid or preflight_transaction_guard for a combined consensus + RBF verdict with signed attestation.

rawTxHex.description: Hexadecimal signed raw Bitcoin transaction to simulate

tools.name: verify_block_header
tools.description: Read-only, side-effect-free query returning the latest mined Bitcoin mainnet block header (height, hash, difficulty, timestamp) directly from Bitcoin Core RPC. Use this to anchor chain tip state or verify finality; use get_next_block_xray to inspect the unmined candidate block template.

tools.name: inspect_eip7702_authorization
tools.description: Read-only, side-effect-free security audit of an EIP-7702 (Pectra) authorization_list for wallet drainer bytecode, dangerous opcodes (SELFDESTRUCT, unverified DELEGATECALL), and chainId=0 cross-chain replay risk. Use this specifically when signing or reviewing EIP-7702 authorization tuples; use inspect_evm_address_safety for general EOA/proxy/token risk, simulate_evm_tx for full calldata execution, or preflight_transaction_guard for a unified ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK verdict.

tools.name: simulate_evm_tx
tools.description: Read-only, side-effect-free EVM transaction dry-run (eth_call + gas estimation) that decodes revert reasons, detects unlimited ERC-20 approvals, flags EIP-7702 delegation targets, and scores ONNX drainer risk without signing or broadcasting. Use this when you have concrete from/to/data/value calldata to test; use inspect_evm_address_safety to check an address alone, inspect_eip7702_authorization for Pectra authorization_list tuples, or preflight_transaction_guard for a unified ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK guardrail.

value.description: Optional wei value as decimal or 0x-hex string (default 0x0)

tools.name: inspect_evm_address_safety
tools.description: Read-only, side-effect-free EVM address and contract classification (EOA, EIP-7702 delegated EOA, EIP-1967 proxy, or ERC-20 token) checking privileged mint/pause/blacklist controls, SELFDESTRUCT opcodes, and ONNX drainer score. Use this before interacting with an unfamiliar address or contract; use simulate_evm_tx to dry-run specific transaction calldata, inspect_eip7702_authorization to audit EIP-7702 authorization_list tuples, or preflight_transaction_guard for a combined ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK verdict.

tools.name: preflight_transaction_guard
tools.description: Read-only, side-effect-free unified pre-sign guardrail returning ALLOW, WARN, or BLOCK with cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 node attestation (10x SLA Service Credit) across EVM (simulation + address safety + EIP-7702) or BTC (consensus simulation + RBF shield) plus optional stablecoin peg risk. Use this as the primary one-call pre-sign gate before executing any EVM or BTC transfer; use simulate_evm_tx, inspect_evm_address_safety, inspect_eip7702_authorization, simulate_raw_transaction, or check_rbf_fraud_shield when you only need a single specialized check.

rawTxHex.description: Optional signed raw BTC transaction hex (for btc protocol)

txid.description: Optional BTC txid for RBF shield (for btc protocol)
